responsibility: Defines the drop-range analysis used by generator interior type checking: the tracked-value and per-node state model, the public DropRanges query interface, and the top-level pipeline that gathers consumed/borrowed places, builds the CFG, propagates definitely-dropped facts, and returns whether values or borrowed temporaries are live at yield-relevant locations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `generator_interior/mod.rs`, which decides which types remain in a generator’s saved interior and emits suspension diagnostics, this `mod.rs` is the lower-level dataflow submodule that computes per-HIR-node drop/liveness facts and borrowed temporaries used by that higher-level interior analysis. Unlike `fn_ctxt/mod.rs` or `method/mod.rs`, it is a narrow generator-specific analysis helper, not a general type-checking or method-resolution entry module.
